stageNotes.1-canonical: Both apex and www return 200 cleanly under production UA. www does NOT canonicalize (canonical = apex). HTTP server: nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu) - bare origin, no CDN.
stageNotes.2-waf: No WAF detected (hasWaf=false). All 8 probe batches 200 across 4 UAs. Honeypot paths return 404 (not 403 - server-level path-mapping, not WAF filtering). Sustained-walk test of pagination through page 424 stayed 200 (extended Mistake 23 + B9 confirmation).
stageNotes.3-platform: Next.js custom classifieds app. Detected via /_next/image, /_next/static/chunks, link rel=preload patterns. NOT WordPress/Shopify/Drupal/Magento. No reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/Turnstile in homepage HTML. No age-gate (no DOB form, no 18+ button, no agegate cookie). adapterType=classifieds-gunpost chosen because it's the closest existing adapter family (Canadian firearms classifieds); a generic-classifieds adapter would also work. Crawl path serves products in SSR'd HTML - needsPlaywright=false.
stageNotes.4-catalog: Stage 4 conservative scope: catalogUrls=['/category/guns'] only. The /category/guns URL aggregates products from MANY URL patterns (/marketplace/<city>/guns/*, /marketplace/<city>/sporting-goods/* when tagged guns category, etc.) and reaches the full firearms classifieds inventory via pagination. Per-province URLs (/buysell/<province>/guns) 308-redirect (unstable). Sub-facets exist (/category/guns?type=firearms, ?type=ammunition, ?type=optics, ?type=parts, ?type=storage, ?action=automatic|bolt|double-barreled|...) but ALL are subsets of /category/guns. Walked-unique guns count 8889 matches Stage 8 count exactly (same source).
stageNotes.5-pagination: ?page=N honored: page 1 -> page 2 zero overlap (0 intersection between 21+21 product sets). Last page = 424 (21 IDs); page 425+ silently wraps to page 1 (newest). perPage=21 is HARD CODED (no <select name=limit>, no ?limit param accepted - confirmed by inspection; the page is server-rendered with fixed grid). firstPageHasParam=false (page 1 reached via bare /category/guns).
stageNotes.6-sort: No explicit ?sort= or ?orderBy= query param honored. Sort UI is a Radix combobox (role=combobox, aria-controls=radix-_R_...) - fully client-side, not in URL. Counter-control: tried ?sort=newest, ?sort=date, ?orderBy=date - all returned default order. HOWEVER: default order IS newest-first (independently verified by monotonic descent of numeric IDs across pages 1->424: max ID descends 1171326->945865). sortParam=null but watermark crawler relies on default-newest ordering. sortVerified=false because there is no explicit sort param; rely on DOM order proof for navigate-from-watermark.
stageNotes.7-watermark: navigate-from-watermark: Page 1 is newest (monotonic ID descent independently verified across 421 pages). Walks backward from newest to find watermark, then indexes forward. Numeric sourceId is exposed in product URL (extractable from /marketplace/.../<id>) - usable as monotonic watermark cursor.
stageNotes.8-count: html-pagination walk: lastPage=424 (binary-search confirmed), perPage=21, lastPagePartial=6 -> total = 423*21 + 6 = 8889 firearm-relevant listings. Sitemap-based count rejected because /sitemap.xml is mixed (events/businesses/users) and marketplace/sitemap.xml is INCOMPLETE (only 28968 URLs site-wide for all categories; the buysell + category sitemaps contain category-filter URLs, not products).
stageNotes.9-assembly: Stage 9: all 9 required fields populated. classifiedRules.soldDetection populated (sold listings have 'Sold ~' or 'Sold' prefix in user-edited title - there is NO platform-level sold class or status badge). productUrlSchemes records the /marketplace/<city>/<cat>/<slug>/<id> canonical pattern. searchUrl omitted because the site uses /search (a search PAGE, not a URL template); R2 should drive Playwright to confirm whether the search box maps to a URL template.
